message.hero_supporting_text: Tell us about your manufacturing business, confirmed orders and financing need. We will review whether Kanan may be able to support the next step.
message.finance_value_title: Make your requirement easier to review
message.finance_value_body: Where appropriate, Kanan may help clarify the requirement and organize supporting evidence before a bank or NBFC reviews it.
message.risk_diagnostic_body: Selected manufacturers may also receive a later, human-reviewed analysis of external developments that could affect materials, cost, logistics, compliance, production or delivery.
message.risk_scope_note: A risk is included only where a clear connection to an input, source, process or route can be shown.
message.how_it_works_step_1: Share basic details about your business and requirement.
message.how_it_works_step_2: Kanan reviews whether the requirement may fit the support programme.
message.how_it_works_step_3: Selected applicants are contacted for documents and next steps.
message.response_time_copy: We confirm receipt immediately and contact you after human review.
message.lender_boundary_copy: Kanan Labs is not a bank or NBFC. We do not lend, underwrite or approve credit, handle loan funds, or guarantee finance. Any financing decision is made only by the relevant financial institution.
message.privacy_microcopy: We use the information you submit to review this request and contact you about it. We will not share it with a financial institution without your authorization.
message.submission_confirmation: Application received. This confirms receipt only, not eligibility or approval.
message.explicit_no_charge_variant: For selected applicants, the Global Disruption Review is provided at no charge.
